verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs say self-hosted deployments run on 'your own LLM keys or a local model', and organizations can set models. That shows bring-your-own-LLM and some vendor independence. However, the evidence never lists which providers are supported and ties BYO-LLM mainly to self-hosting. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported LLM providers or model-configuration docs, evidence of BYO-LLM on the cloud product rather than only self-hosted, and independent hands-on corroboration of running non-OpenAI or local models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models

citations.quote: using your own LLM keys or a local model
Self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your infrastructure: your servers, your browsers, your LLM API keys.
Run Skyvern on your own infrastructure with your own LLM keys.
